description: Influence of Linear, Mixed-Integer Linear, Piecewise-Linear, and Nonlinear Thermal Power Flow Models on District Heating Network Design is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jerry Lambert, Linus Hermanns (Technical University of Munich). The following files contain the datasets needed to reproduce the results of the publication "Influence of Linear, Mixed-Integer Linear, Piecewise-Linear, and Nonlinear Thermal Power Flow Models on District Heating Network Design", submitted to Applied Energy. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
